immersive.note: Foundation only — do not redesign Life Setup / conversation internals

legacy_aliases.surface: maps to semantic surface / backgroundPrimary depending on context

rules: Never hardcode colors in components — use semantic tokens.
Never use pure black #000000 for surfaces.
Never use electric blue or purple as primary accent.
Light mode is designed, not inverted dark.
Glass only for tab bar, bottom sheet, floating controls — never cards.

spacing.rule: Strict Apple HIG spacing. Generous vertical breathing room. Prefer 16–24pt margins.

accessibility.dynamicType: prefer semantic typography; avoid fixed tiny labels
accessibility.contrast: high contrast text on surfaces; verify WCAG AA for primary text
accessibility.focusOrder: top-to-bottom, primary action last in card when natural

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar so content scrolls cleanly behind it.
Use on bottom sheets and floating controls.
Keep the blur soft and tint from surfaceGlass semantic token.
dont's: Do not use glass on priority cards or standard list items.
Do not use behind dense text or inputs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow ORA Quiet Premium. Apple HIG is the base. References: Apple Calendar/Journal/Reminders/Health, Things 3, Notion Mobile, Arc Search, Day One — NOT Linear.
Accent is Deep Indigo (#3D4A8C). Never electric blue, never purple, never pure black surfaces.
Light and dark are both designed. Use ThemeProvider (light / dark / system). Prefer useTheme()/useColors() for new UI; legacy tokens.* aliases remain for existing screens.
Never hardcode hex in components. Use semantic tokens from frontend/src/theme.
Glass only on tab bar, bottom sheets, floating controls. Cards are solid AppCard surfaces.
Application Shell V1: declare ambient | focus | immersive via frontend/src/shell. Ambient IA is Home · Contesti · ORA · Memoria · Profilo.
ORA center opens Conversation Engine — never a new chat, never Aggiungi FAB aesthetics.
Focus chrome: back OR close (not both); hide fake 0% progress; no Ambient nav on Action.
No new UI libraries (NativeBase, Tamagui, Paper, UI Kitten, Tailwind UI).
Primitives in frontend/src/components/ui are available — adopt gradually; do not rewrite all screens in one PR.
The app must feel calm and intelligent. Space and typography hierarchy over chrome. Never dashboard density.
Micro-motion: press scale 0.97, gentle stagger, semantic haptics. Prefer reduced-motion when system requests it. Ambient↔Focus ~220–280ms.
Accessibility: 44pt min touch, VoiceOver labels, high contrast primary text, Dynamic Type-friendly type scale. ORA tab accessibilityLabel: Apri ORA.
